_comment: Tags excluded from default PR Maestro batches. Zephyr tier labels: detox/maestro/README.md.
_MM-T5611: Skip iOS: CI run 30000635898 — external browser launch did not return to the Home tab.
_MM-T3260: Skip Android: CI run 30331493720 (PR #9893, SHA 9f1496e) — help_url.yml failed with 'Unable to launch app com.mattermost.rnbeta' after ~136s (batch-7); already excluded on iOS for browser hand-off flakes. Chrome Custom Tab hand-off leaves the driver unable to relaunch the app on API 35.
_DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: The 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' failures below were NOT login failures. wait_for_server_connect_complete.yml marked the login-form wait optional and then asserted the home tab, so a failed SERVER CONNECT was reported with a login error message. Proof: on run 30466684108 the app issued ZERO /api/v4 requests and logged 'getServerUrlAfterRedirect error' — it never left the server form, so login.yml never executed. Two distinct connect causes were found: (1) TLS trust evaluation cancelled against a valid Let's Encrypt chain (NSURLErrorDomain -1200 + NSURLErrorFailingURLPeerTrustErrorKey, 'Cancelled during verify block' x4 in the red run, x0 in the green run 30437339535) while the runner itself reached the same host over HTTPS to seed data; (2) inputText dropped ~30 characters of SITE_1_URL, so the app connected to 'h-1-tjrchzrq.test.mattermost.cloud' and got 'hostname could not be found' (30447839548 batch-2). Before un-excluding anything below, re-read the sim log for these signatures — do NOT re-tune login.yml.
_MM-T1325: Skip iOS: CI run 30334294934 (PR #9893, SHA 347842c) — clock_display.yml failed with 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~215s). See _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: this message indicates server connect, not login, and was never re-verified against the sim log for this tag. Keep Android coverage.
_MM-T67856_1_2: Skip iOS: both flows PASSED on run 30424009936 (#9893, f86f99e) and FAILED on run 30447839548 (72c6f256c) with identical code — same config, opposite outcomes. Failure is 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~232-282s). See _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: batch-1 of that run was the TLS trust cancellation and batch-2 was the dropped-keystroke URL corruption — neither is a login flake, and the login.yml retry/eraseText/100s-home-wait changes made for these tags were tuning a subflow that never ran. Keep Android coverage — both flows pass there (~108-143s).
_SEC-11051_STATUS: SEC-11051 test-harness foundation is on main (PR #9971): _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION, _connect_check.yml preflight, connect_server_ios.yml retry-only-on-definitive-error, and the fatal arbiter that reports connect-not-login. _enter_url_and_connect.yml already re-enters SITE_1_URL every attempt to mitigate dropped inputText chars. Remaining runbook asks NOT done: (a) set-and-verify input (assert the field equals SITE_1_URL before submit) — deferred because _enter_url_and_connect.yml is a shared subflow used by EVERY iOS Maestro test, so an unverified text assertion could break the whole iOS suite; (b) 3x consecutive green + unskip of MM-T67856_1/_2 — blocked by the TLS cold-start cancellation (NSURLErrorDomain -1200, 'Cancelled during verify block'), which the runbook flags as a possible PE/infra handoff (app cancelling trust prematurely on cold start vs simulator trust store vs torn-down network is undetermined locally; CI-cited evidence stands, not reproduced here). MM-T67856_1/_2 stay iOS-excluded. SEC-11000 (MM-T1325) and SEC-11018 (MM-T5611) are already iOS-excluded with _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION references — flagged, not fixed here.
